where.S: {ALIAS}.TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE('${FECHA_INICIO}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND {ALIAS}.TIME_STAMP < TO_DATE('${FECHA_FIN}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND {ALIAS}.STATUS IN (${STATUS_OPERACION})

consulta_sql.S: SELECT DISTINCT PD.* FROM {SCHEMA}.POLICYDCO PD WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {SCHEMA}.CONTEXTOPERATION CTX WHERE CTX.ID = PD.OPERATIONPK AND CTX.STATUS IN (${STATUS_OPERACION}) AND CTX.TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE('${FECHA_INICIO}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND CTX.TIME_STAMP < TO_DATE('${FECHA_FIN}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))

SELECT DISTINCT AP.* FROM {SCHEMA}.AGREGATEDPOLICY AP LEFT JOIN {SCHEMA}.PRODUCT PR ON PR.PRODUCTID = AP.PRODUCTID WHERE (AP.PRODUCTID IN (48897,55059,54999,54959,52897,54979,55099) OR PR.DESCRIPTION IN (${PRODUCTOS})) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {SCHEMA}.POLICYDCO PD JOIN {SCHEMA}.CONTEXTOPERATION CTX ON CTX.ID = PD.OPERATIONPK WHERE PD.AGREGATEDOBJECTID = AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID AND CTX.STATUS IN (${STATUS_OPERACION}) AND CTX.TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE('${FECHA_INICIO}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND CTX.TIME_STAMP < TO_DATE('${FECHA_FIN}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))

SELECT DISTINCT PP.* FROM {SCHEMA}.PREPOLICY PP WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {SCHEMA}.POLICYDCO PD JOIN {SCHEMA}.CONTEXTOPERATION CTX ON CTX.ID = PD.OPERATIONPK JOIN {SCHEMA}.AGREGATEDPOLICY AP ON AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID = PD.AGREGATEDOBJECTID LEFT JOIN {SCHEMA}.PRODUCT PR ON PR.PRODUCTID = AP.PRODUCTID WHERE PD.DCOID = PP.PK AND CTX.STATUS IN (${STATUS_OPERACION}) AND CTX.TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE('${FECHA_INICIO}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND CTX.TIME_STAMP < TO_DATE('${FECHA_FIN}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND (AP.PRODUCTID IN (48897,55059,54999,54959,52897,54979,55099) OR PR.DESCRIPTION IN (${PRODUCTOS})))

SELECT DISTINCT EVT.* FROM {SCHEMA}.EVENTDCO EVT WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {SCHEMA}.POLICYDCO PD JOIN {SCHEMA}.CONTEXTOPERATION CTX ON CTX.ID = PD.OPERATIONPK JOIN {SCHEMA}.AGREGATEDPOLICY AP ON AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID = PD.AGREGATEDOBJECTID LEFT JOIN {SCHEMA}.PRODUCT PR ON PR.PRODUCTID = AP.PRODUCTID WHERE PD.OPERATIONPK = EVT.OPERATIONPK AND PD.IDDCOEVENT = EVT.IDDCOEVENT AND CTX.STATUS IN (${STATUS_OPERACION}) AND CTX.TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE('${FECHA_INICIO}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND CTX.TIME_STAMP < TO_DATE('${FECHA_FIN}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND (AP.PRODUCTID IN (48897,55059,54999,54959,52897,54979,55099) OR PR.DESCRIPTION IN (${PRODUCTOS})))

SELECT DISTINCT RU.* FROM {SCHEMA}.RISKUNITDCO RU WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {SCHEMA}.POLICYDCO PD JOIN {SCHEMA}.CONTEXTOPERATION CTX ON CTX.ID = PD.OPERATIONPK JOIN {SCHEMA}.AGREGATEDPOLICY AP ON AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID = PD.AGREGATEDOBJECTID LEFT JOIN {SCHEMA}.PRODUCT PR ON PR.PRODUCTID = AP.PRODUCTID WHERE PD.OPERATIONPK = RU.OPERATIONPK AND CTX.STATUS IN (${STATUS_OPERACION}) AND CTX.TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE('${FECHA_INICIO}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND CTX.TIME_STAMP < TO_DATE('${FECHA_FIN}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND (AP.PRODUCTID IN (48897,55059,54999,54959,52897,54979,55099) OR PR.DESCRIPTION IN (${PRODUCTOS})))
SELECT DISTINCT PR.* FROM {SCHEMA}.PRODUCT PR WHERE PR.PRODUCTID IN (48897,55059,54999,54959,52897,54979,55099) OR PR.DESCRIPTION IN (${PRODUCTOS})

SELECT /*+ parallel(3) */ DISTINCT U.*
FROM {SCHEMA}.URVDEUDORES U
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM {SCHEMA}.RISKUNITDCO R
    JOIN {SCHEMA}.CONTEXTOPERATION C
      ON C.ID = R.OPERATIONPK
    JOIN {SCHEMA}.POLICYDCO P
      ON P.OPERATIONPK = C.ID
    JOIN {SCHEMA}.AGREGATEDPOLICY AP
      ON AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID = P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID
     AND AP.PRODUCTID IN (${PRODUCTOS})
    JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPOLICY PPL
      ON PPL.PK = P.DCOID
    JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPRODUCT PPR
      ON PPR.STATIC = AP.PRODUCTID
     AND PPR.STATIC = 48897
     AND PPR.COMPANIAVALUE IN (${COMPANIAS})
    JOIN {SCHEMA}.STPS_RELATIONAGREEMENTPOLICY SR
      ON SR.RSA_POLICYID = PPL.STATIC
    WHERE R.DCOID = U.PK
      AND C.STATUS IN (${STATUS_OPERACION})
      AND C.TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE('${FECHA_INICIO}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
      AND C.TIME_STAMP < TO_DATE('${FECHA_FIN}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
)

SELECT /*+ parallel(3) */ T.AGREGATEDOBJECTID, T.AGREGATEDPARENTID, T.AUDITDATE, T.DCOID, T.DESCRIPTION, T.EVENT, T.FINISHDATE, T.IDDCOEVENT, T.INITIALDATE, T.OPERATIONPK, T.STATUS, T.TIME_STAMP
FROM {SCHEMA}.INSURANCEOBJECTDCO T
JOIN (
 SELECT I.OPERATIONPK,I.AGREGATEDPARENTID,MIN(I.AGREGATEDOBJECTID) AGREGATEDOBJECTID
 FROM {SCHEMA}.INSURANCEOBJECTDCO I
 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT C.ID OPERATIONPK, P.DCOID POLICY_DCOID, P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID POLICY_ID, P.IDDCOEVENT, AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID, AP.PRODUCTID, R.DCOID RISK_DCOID, R.AGREGATEDOBJECTID RISK_ID, R.INITIALDATE RISK_INITIALDATE
FROM {SCHEMA}.CONTEXTOPERATION C
JOIN {SCHEMA}.POLICYDCO P ON P.OPERATIONPK=C.ID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.AGREGATEDPOLICY AP ON AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID=P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID
LEFT JOIN {SCHEMA}.PRODUCT PR ON PR.PRODUCTID = AP.PRODUCTID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPRODUCT PP ON PP.STATIC=AP.PRODUCTID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPOLICY PPL ON PPL.PK=P.DCOID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.EVENTDCO E ON E.OPERATIONPK=P.OPERATIONPK AND E.IDDCOEVENT=P.IDDCOEVENT
JOIN {SCHEMA}.RISKUNITDCO R ON R.OPERATIONPK=P.OPERATIONPK
WHERE C.STATUS IN (${STATUS_OPERACION})
AND C.TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE('${FECHA_INICIO}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.TIME_STAMP < TO_DATE('${FECHA_FIN}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND AP.PRODUCTID IN (${PRODUCTOS}) AND PP.STATIC = 48897 AND PP.COMPANIAVALUE IN (${COMPANIAS})) U ON U.OPERATIONPK=I.OPERATIONPK AND U.RISK_ID=I.AGREGATEDPARENTID
 GROUP BY I.OPERATIONPK,I.AGREGATEDPARENTID
) M ON M.OPERATIONPK=T.OPERATIONPK AND M.AGREGATEDPARENTID=T.AGREGATEDPARENTID AND M.AGREGATEDOBJECTID=T.AGREGATEDOBJECTID
WHERE T.STATUS=1

where.S: {ALIAS}.STATUS = 1 AND {ALIAS}.AGREGATEDOBJECTID = (SELECT MIN(IODCO1.AGREGATEDOBJECTID) FROM ACSELE_ALFA.INSURANCEOBJECTDCO IODCO1 WHERE IODCO1.AGREGATEDPARENTID = {ALIAS}.AGREGATEDPARENTID AND IODCO1.OPERATIONPK = {ALIAS}.OPERATIONPK AND IODCO1.STATUS = 1)

SELECT /*+ parallel(3) */
       AIO.AGREGATEDINSURANCEOBJECTID,
       AIO.AGREGATEDRISKUNITID,
       AIO.OPERATIONPK,
       AIO.TIME_STAMP
FROM ACSELE_ALFA.AGREGATEDINSURANCEOBJECT AIO
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM ACSELE_ALFA.STPO_INSOBJPARTICIPATION P
    JOIN ACSELE_ALFA.STPO_INSOBJPARTICIPATIONDCO PDCO
      ON PDCO.AGREGATEDOBJECTID =
         P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID
     AND PDCO.OPERATIONPK =
         P.OPERATIONPK
     AND PDCO.STATUS = 1
    JOIN ACSELE_ALFA.CONTEXTOPERATION CO
      ON CO.ID = PDCO.OPERATIONPK
    JOIN ACSELE_ALFA.POLICYDCO POL
      ON POL.OPERATIONPK = CO.ID
    JOIN ACSELE_ALFA.AGREGATEDPOLICY AP
      ON AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID =
         POL.AGREGATEDOBJECTID
    JOIN ACSELE_ALFA.PREPRODUCT PRP
      ON PRP.STATIC = AP.PRODUCTID
    WHERE P.AGREGATEDPARENTID =
          AIO.AGREGATEDINSURANCEOBJECTID
      AND CO.STATUS IN (${STATUS_OPERACION})
      AND CO.TIME_STAMP >=
          DATE '{START_DATE}'
      AND CO.TIME_STAMP <
          DATE '{END_DATE}'
      AND PRP.STATIC = 48897
      AND PRP.COMPANIAVALUE IN (${COMPANIAS})
)

SELECT /*+ parallel(3) */ T.CIUDADINPUT, T.CIUDADVALUE, T.DEPARTAMENTOINPUT, T.DEPARTAMENTOVALUE, T.DIRECCIONASEGURADOINPUT, T.DIRECCIONASEGURADOVALUE, T.DOCUMENTOIDENTIDADASEGINPUT, T.DOCUMENTOIDENTIDADASEGVALUE, T.EDADINPUT, T.EDADVALUE, T.FACTORVIDAINPUT, T.FACTORVIDAVALUE, T.FECHANACIMIENTOASEGINPUT, T.FECHANACIMIENTOASEGVALUE, T.MONTOASEGURADOOAINPUT, T.MONTOASEGURADOOAVALUE, T.PK, T.STATIC, T.STATUS, T.TELEFONOINPUT, T.TELEFONOVALUE, T.VALORSEGUROOAINPUT, T.VALORSEGUROOAVALUE
FROM {SCHEMA}.OAVDEUDORES T
WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM {SCHEMA}.INSURANCEOBJECTDCO I
 JOIN (
  SELECT X.OPERATIONPK,X.AGREGATEDPARENTID,MIN(X.AGREGATEDOBJECTID) AGREGATEDOBJECTID
  FROM {SCHEMA}.INSURANCEOBJECTDCO X
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT C.ID OPERATIONPK, P.DCOID POLICY_DCOID, P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID POLICY_ID, P.IDDCOEVENT, AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID, AP.PRODUCTID, R.DCOID RISK_DCOID, R.AGREGATEDOBJECTID RISK_ID, R.INITIALDATE RISK_INITIALDATE
FROM {SCHEMA}.CONTEXTOPERATION C
JOIN {SCHEMA}.POLICYDCO P ON P.OPERATIONPK=C.ID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.AGREGATEDPOLICY AP ON AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID=P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID
LEFT JOIN {SCHEMA}.PRODUCT PR ON PR.PRODUCTID = AP.PRODUCTID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPRODUCT PP ON PP.STATIC=AP.PRODUCTID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPOLICY PPL ON PPL.PK=P.DCOID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.EVENTDCO E ON E.OPERATIONPK=P.OPERATIONPK AND E.IDDCOEVENT=P.IDDCOEVENT
JOIN {SCHEMA}.RISKUNITDCO R ON R.OPERATIONPK=P.OPERATIONPK
WHERE C.STATUS IN (${STATUS_OPERACION})
AND C.TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE('${FECHA_INICIO}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.TIME_STAMP < TO_DATE('${FECHA_FIN}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND AP.PRODUCTID IN (${PRODUCTOS}) AND PP.STATIC = 48897 AND PP.COMPANIAVALUE IN (${COMPANIAS})) U ON U.OPERATIONPK=X.OPERATIONPK AND U.RISK_ID=X.AGREGATEDPARENTID
  GROUP BY X.OPERATIONPK,X.AGREGATEDPARENTID
 ) M ON M.OPERATIONPK=I.OPERATIONPK AND M.AGREGATEDPARENTID=I.AGREGATEDPARENTID AND M.AGREGATEDOBJECTID=I.AGREGATEDOBJECTID
 WHERE I.STATUS=1 AND I.DCOID=T.PK
)

SELECT /*+ parallel(3) */ T.AGREGATEDOBJECTID, T.AGREGATEDPARENTID, T.DESCRIPTION, T.OPERATIONPK, T.ROL_ID, T.THIRDPARTYID, T.TIME_STAMP FROM {SCHEMA}.STPO_POLICYPARTICIPATION T WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT C.ID OPERATIONPK, P.DCOID POLICY_DCOID, P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID POLICY_ID, P.IDDCOEVENT, AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID, AP.PRODUCTID, R.DCOID RISK_DCOID, R.AGREGATEDOBJECTID RISK_ID, R.INITIALDATE RISK_INITIALDATE
FROM {SCHEMA}.CONTEXTOPERATION C
JOIN {SCHEMA}.POLICYDCO P ON P.OPERATIONPK=C.ID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.AGREGATEDPOLICY AP ON AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID=P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID
LEFT JOIN {SCHEMA}.PRODUCT PR ON PR.PRODUCTID = AP.PRODUCTID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPRODUCT PP ON PP.STATIC=AP.PRODUCTID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPOLICY PPL ON PPL.PK=P.DCOID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.EVENTDCO E ON E.OPERATIONPK=P.OPERATIONPK AND E.IDDCOEVENT=P.IDDCOEVENT
JOIN {SCHEMA}.RISKUNITDCO R ON R.OPERATIONPK=P.OPERATIONPK
WHERE C.STATUS IN (${STATUS_OPERACION})
AND C.TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE('${FECHA_INICIO}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.TIME_STAMP < TO_DATE('${FECHA_FIN}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND AP.PRODUCTID IN (${PRODUCTOS}) AND PP.STATIC = 48897 AND PP.COMPANIAVALUE IN (${COMPANIAS})) U WHERE U.AGREGATEDPOLICYID=T.AGREGATEDPARENTID)

SELECT /*+ parallel(3) */ T.ADDRESSBOOKID, T.ADDRESSBOOKMAILID, T.AGREGATEDOBJECTID, T.AUDITDATE, T.DCOID, T.OPERATIONPK, T.STATUS, T.TIME_STAMP FROM {SCHEMA}.STPO_POLICYPARTICIPATIONDCO T
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {SCHEMA}.STPO_POLICYPARTICIPATION P JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT C.ID OPERATIONPK, P.DCOID POLICY_DCOID, P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID POLICY_ID, P.IDDCOEVENT, AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID, AP.PRODUCTID, R.DCOID RISK_DCOID, R.AGREGATEDOBJECTID RISK_ID, R.INITIALDATE RISK_INITIALDATE
FROM {SCHEMA}.CONTEXTOPERATION C
JOIN {SCHEMA}.POLICYDCO P ON P.OPERATIONPK=C.ID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.AGREGATEDPOLICY AP ON AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID=P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID
LEFT JOIN {SCHEMA}.PRODUCT PR ON PR.PRODUCTID = AP.PRODUCTID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPRODUCT PP ON PP.STATIC=AP.PRODUCTID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPOLICY PPL ON PPL.PK=P.DCOID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.EVENTDCO E ON E.OPERATIONPK=P.OPERATIONPK AND E.IDDCOEVENT=P.IDDCOEVENT
JOIN {SCHEMA}.RISKUNITDCO R ON R.OPERATIONPK=P.OPERATIONPK
WHERE C.STATUS IN (${STATUS_OPERACION})
AND C.TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE('${FECHA_INICIO}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.TIME_STAMP < TO_DATE('${FECHA_FIN}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND AP.PRODUCTID IN (${PRODUCTOS}) AND PP.STATIC = 48897 AND PP.COMPANIAVALUE IN (${COMPANIAS})) U ON U.AGREGATEDPOLICYID=P.AGREGATEDPARENTID WHERE P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID=T.AGREGATEDOBJECTID AND P.OPERATIONPK=T.OPERATIONPK)

SELECT /*+ parallel(3) */ T.ADDRESSBOOKID, T.ADDRESSBOOKMAILID, T.AGREGATEDOBJECTID, T.AUDITDATE, T.DCOID, T.OPERATIONPK, T.STATUS, T.TIME_STAMP FROM {SCHEMA}.STPO_INSOBJPARTICIPATIONDCO T WHERE T.STATUS=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT C.ID OPERATIONPK, P.DCOID POLICY_DCOID, P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID POLICY_ID, P.IDDCOEVENT, AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID, AP.PRODUCTID, R.DCOID RISK_DCOID, R.AGREGATEDOBJECTID RISK_ID, R.INITIALDATE RISK_INITIALDATE
FROM {SCHEMA}.CONTEXTOPERATION C
JOIN {SCHEMA}.POLICYDCO P ON P.OPERATIONPK=C.ID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.AGREGATEDPOLICY AP ON AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID=P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID
LEFT JOIN {SCHEMA}.PRODUCT PR ON PR.PRODUCTID = AP.PRODUCTID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPRODUCT PP ON PP.STATIC=AP.PRODUCTID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPOLICY PPL ON PPL.PK=P.DCOID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.EVENTDCO E ON E.OPERATIONPK=P.OPERATIONPK AND E.IDDCOEVENT=P.IDDCOEVENT
JOIN {SCHEMA}.RISKUNITDCO R ON R.OPERATIONPK=P.OPERATIONPK
WHERE C.STATUS IN (${STATUS_OPERACION})
AND C.TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE('${FECHA_INICIO}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.TIME_STAMP < TO_DATE('${FECHA_FIN}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND AP.PRODUCTID IN (${PRODUCTOS}) AND PP.STATIC = 48897 AND PP.COMPANIAVALUE IN (${COMPANIAS})) U WHERE U.OPERATIONPK=T.OPERATIONPK)

SELECT /*+ parallel(3) */ T.AGREGATEDOBJECTID, T.AGREGATEDPARENTID, T.DESCRIPTION, T.OPERATIONPK, T.ROL_ID, T.THIRDPARTYID, T.TIME_STAMP FROM {SCHEMA}.STPO_INSOBJPARTICIPATION T
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {SCHEMA}.STPO_INSOBJPARTICIPATIONDCO D JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT C.ID OPERATIONPK, P.DCOID POLICY_DCOID, P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID POLICY_ID, P.IDDCOEVENT, AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID, AP.PRODUCTID, R.DCOID RISK_DCOID, R.AGREGATEDOBJECTID RISK_ID, R.INITIALDATE RISK_INITIALDATE
FROM {SCHEMA}.CONTEXTOPERATION C
JOIN {SCHEMA}.POLICYDCO P ON P.OPERATIONPK=C.ID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.AGREGATEDPOLICY AP ON AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID=P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID
LEFT JOIN {SCHEMA}.PRODUCT PR ON PR.PRODUCTID = AP.PRODUCTID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPRODUCT PP ON PP.STATIC=AP.PRODUCTID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPOLICY PPL ON PPL.PK=P.DCOID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.EVENTDCO E ON E.OPERATIONPK=P.OPERATIONPK AND E.IDDCOEVENT=P.IDDCOEVENT
JOIN {SCHEMA}.RISKUNITDCO R ON R.OPERATIONPK=P.OPERATIONPK
WHERE C.STATUS IN (${STATUS_OPERACION})
AND C.TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE('${FECHA_INICIO}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.TIME_STAMP < TO_DATE('${FECHA_FIN}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND AP.PRODUCTID IN (${PRODUCTOS}) AND PP.STATIC = 48897 AND PP.COMPANIAVALUE IN (${COMPANIAS})) U ON U.OPERATIONPK=D.OPERATIONPK WHERE D.STATUS=1 AND D.AGREGATEDOBJECTID=T.AGREGATEDOBJECTID)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {SCHEMA}.AGREGATEDINSURANCEOBJECT A WHERE A.AGREGATEDINSURANCEOBJECTID=T.AGREGATEDPARENTID)

SELECT /*+ parallel(3) */ T.AMMOUNT, T.CONCEPT, T.DESCPROPERTY, T.OPERATIONPK, T.PK, T.POLICYID, T.ROL_ID, T.STATUS, T.THIRDPARTY FROM {SCHEMA}.THIRDPARTYMOVEMENTPOLICY T WHERE T.AMMOUNT <> 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT C.ID OPERATIONPK, P.DCOID POLICY_DCOID, P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID POLICY_ID, P.IDDCOEVENT, AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID, AP.PRODUCTID, R.DCOID RISK_DCOID, R.AGREGATEDOBJECTID RISK_ID, R.INITIALDATE RISK_INITIALDATE
FROM {SCHEMA}.CONTEXTOPERATION C
JOIN {SCHEMA}.POLICYDCO P ON P.OPERATIONPK=C.ID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.AGREGATEDPOLICY AP ON AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID=P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID
LEFT JOIN {SCHEMA}.PRODUCT PR ON PR.PRODUCTID = AP.PRODUCTID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPRODUCT PP ON PP.STATIC=AP.PRODUCTID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPOLICY PPL ON PPL.PK=P.DCOID
JOIN {SCHEMA}.EVENTDCO E ON E.OPERATIONPK=P.OPERATIONPK AND E.IDDCOEVENT=P.IDDCOEVENT
JOIN {SCHEMA}.RISKUNITDCO R ON R.OPERATIONPK=P.OPERATIONPK
WHERE C.STATUS IN (${STATUS_OPERACION})
AND C.TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE('${FECHA_INICIO}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND C.TIME_STAMP < TO_DATE('${FECHA_FIN}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND AP.PRODUCTID IN (${PRODUCTOS}) AND PP.STATIC = 48897 AND PP.COMPANIAVALUE IN (${COMPANIAS})) U WHERE U.OPERATIONPK=T.OPERATIONPK)

WITH BASE_POLIZAS AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID
    FROM {SCHEMA}.CONTEXTOPERATION C
    JOIN {SCHEMA}.POLICYDCO PD
      ON PD.OPERATIONPK = C.ID
    JOIN {SCHEMA}.AGREGATEDPOLICY AP
      ON AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID = PD.AGREGATEDOBJECTID
    JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPRODUCT PP
      ON PP.STATIC = AP.PRODUCTID
    WHERE C.STATUS IN (${STATUS_OPERACION})
      AND C.TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE(
          '${FECHA_INICIO}',
          'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
      )
      AND C.TIME_STAMP < TO_DATE(
          '${FECHA_FIN}',
          'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
      )
      AND AP.PRODUCTID IN (${PRODUCTOS})
      AND PP.STATIC = 48897
      AND PP.COMPANIAVALUE IN (${COMPANIAS})
),
THIRD_PARTY_KEYS AS (
    SELECT P.THIRDPARTYID
    FROM {SCHEMA}.STPO_POLICYPARTICIPATION P
    JOIN BASE_POLIZAS B
      ON B.AGREGATEDPOLICYID = P.AGREGATEDPARENTID
    WHERE P.THIRDPARTYID IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT I.THIRDPARTYID
    FROM {SCHEMA}.STPO_INSOBJPARTICIPATION I
    WHERE I.THIRDPARTYID IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM {SCHEMA}.STPO_POLICYPARTICIPATION P
          JOIN BASE_POLIZAS B
            ON B.AGREGATEDPOLICYID = P.AGREGATEDPARENTID
          WHERE P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID =
                I.AGREGATEDPARENTID
      )
)
SELECT
    T.DOCUMENTOIDENTIDADINPUT,
    T.DOCUMENTOIDENTIDADVALUE,
    T.EMAILINPUT,
    T.EMAILVALUE,
    T.NOMBREPREDETERMINADOINPUT,
    T.NOMBREPREDETERMINADOVALUE,
    T.PK,
    T.STATIC,
    T.STATUS,
    T.TELEFONOOFICINACOMPLETINPUT,
    T.TELEFONOOFICINACOMPLETVALUE,
    T.TIPODOCUMENTOINPUT,
    T.TIPODOCUMENTOVALUE
FROM {SCHEMA}.PRETHIRDPARTY T
JOIN THIRD_PARTY_KEYS K
  ON K.THIRDPARTYID = T.STATIC
